Round3_Claim: AAP standard <=50.0dBA (claimed as official pediatric product ceiling)
Literature_Or_Standard_Source: Hugh et al. (Pediatrics 2014; 133(4): e862-e868); AAP Committee on Environmental Health (1997)
Actual_Experimental_Condition: AAP 1997 recommended hospital neonatal nursery and NICU continuous ambient noise <=50dBA. Hugh et al. tested 14 infant sleep machines at 30cm, 100cm, 200cm.
Physical_Or_Mathematical_Relationship: A-weighted equivalent continuous sound level (L_Aeq). Decreases by 6dB per doubling of distance in free field.
Distorted_Or_Conflated_Aspects: AAP does NOT have an official commercial product certification standard of 50dBA at 10cm. Conflated hospital nursery ambient guidelines with product certification.
Reconciled_Engineering_Interpretation: Treat <=50.0dBA as an internal candidate engineering target for normal soothing mode at 30cm (not official AAP product certification).
Mandatory_Action_Required: Formalize acoustic test protocol specifying: distance=30cm, duration=10min, background noise <30dBA, A-weighting.

Actual_Experimental_Condition: Hugh et al. documented machines producing 65-85+ dBA. 2023 AAP policy advises lowest volume, maximum distance, time limits.

Round3_Claim: 0.5g acceleration misread from 0.5Hz in earlier reports
Literature_Or_Standard_Source: Kimura et al. (2017), Evaluation of the Effect of Insensible Rocking Movement on Sleep
Actual_Experimental_Condition: Macroscopic bed rocking at 0.5Hz (30 cycles/min) with stroke displacement 2.4mm to 7.5mm on adult/infant beds.
Physical_Or_Mathematical_Relationship: a_peak = (2*pi*f)^2 * A. At 0.5Hz: A=2.4mm -> a_peak=0.0024g; A=7.5mm -> a_peak=0.0075g.
Distorted_Or_Conflated_Aspects: Earlier reports misread the unit 0.5Hz as 0.5g. 0.5g at 0.5Hz would require an impossible displacement of 50cm.
Reconciled_Engineering_Interpretation: Unit misread is confirmed and rejected. Kimura 2017 studied gentle 0.5Hz macroscopic rocking (2.4mm-7.5mm); NOT 45Hz exciter vibration.
Mandatory_Action_Required: Permanently remove 0.5g from all engineering documentation.

Round3_Claim: 10um - 15um claimed as direct derivation from Kimura 2017
Literature_Or_Standard_Source: Kimura et al. (2017); internal engineering notes
Actual_Experimental_Condition: Kimura 2017 evaluated mm-scale stroke (2.4mm - 7.5mm) at 0.5Hz. 10-15um is NOT found in Kimura 2017 text.
Physical_Or_Mathematical_Relationship: Displacement A is independent of acceleration without specifying frequency f.
Distorted_Or_Conflated_Aspects: Round 3 claimed 10-15um was from Kimura 2017. In reality 10-15um is an internal exciter diaphragm amplitude estimate.
Reconciled_Engineering_Interpretation: 10um - 15um must be classified as an unverified internal design hypothesis for 45Hz exciter amplitude; NOT a literature-backed baseline.
Mandatory_Action_Required: Measure physical mattress surface displacement with laser Doppler vibrometer or calibrated accelerometer at 45Hz.
